design_principles.deterministic_probe_identity: Readiness probes require explicit probe_id and deterministic event payloads.
design_principles.exclusive_creation: Sinks created exclusively with O_CREAT | O_EXCL and permissions 0600 (owner read/write only).
design_principles.fail_closed_on_corruption: Any JSON corruption, stage mismatch, or write failure causes an immediate DIAGNOSTIC_INSTRUMENTATION_FAILURE stop.
design_principles.read_only_recovery: Gate recovery checks existing sink content without appending duplicate records or modifying files.
design_principles.retry_observation_integrity: Normal model output retries within an invocation produce legitimate multiple diagnostic observations.

historical_rca2a7_audit.explanation: RCA-2A.7 contains two duplicate synthetic entries resulting from an interrupted gate run. In RCA-2A.7b, these entries remain untouched. The remediated execute_or_verify_readiness_probe prevents recurrence.
